definitions.explanation: The overall feeling or character of a place, situation, or person.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}かった→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: The atmosphere of the meeting was heavy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a unique aura about her.

notes:
USAGE: {雰囲気|ふんいき} describes the intangible feeling of places, events, or people. Very commonly used in everyday conversation.

PRONUNCIATION NOTE: Though written ふんいき, some speakers say ふいんき. The standard pronunciation is ふんいき.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦わるい→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad atmosphere)
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to create atmosphere)
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ (to ruin the atmosphere)
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}まれる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to be overwhelmed by the atmosphere)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雰囲気|ふんいき} (unique atmosphere)
